consolidation_decision.candidate_estimand: Qatar 2022 goalkeeper value from calibrated PSxG prevention, explicit late and match-preserving clutch, non-clutch state leverage, bounded regular penalties, bounded credited-save shootout WPA, and bounded support
consolidation_decision.historical_event_profile_v3_role: frozen audit baseline only after promotion
pre_code_reasoning: Event Profile v3 answers an ordinary process question but over-rewards short-sample rates and compresses decisive tournament actions.
Tournament Impact v4 adds consequence but lets summed ordinary prevention dominate and therefore leaves the decisive champion goalkeeper implausibly low.
A single public estimand is preferable because shot difficulty, timing, match state, shootouts, and support are channels of the same tournament-value question.
Calibrated post-shot goal probability must be the primary shot-stopping check-back so easy saves receive little credit and difficult saves receive more.
Clutch must enter the same score as a residual uplift over ordinary PSxG prevention, preventing the same save from being counted twice at full value.
Named goalkeeper expectations are release fixtures only and are not scorer inputs.
No FIFA rank, award, final placement, team reputation, or raw round-reached bonus will enter the model matrix.

Opponent difficulty will not be added as a separate v5 feature in the preregistered main path; calibrated PSxG and pre-action knockout/match state provide the measurable difficulty and leverage channels.

baseline_to_beat.baseline_interpretation: defective public ordering to improve, not a continuity constraint

soft.S8_difficulty_gradient: PSxG difficulty faced has a reported, non-mandatory association with the top third

channel_contract.psxg: ordinary non-penalty on-target shots in periods 1-4; prevention = calibrated post-shot goal probability - goal outcome
channel_contract.clutch: positive PSxG-checked prevention multiplied by a late/extra-time and match-preserving uplift residual; negative prevention remains in the primary PSxG channel
channel_contract.state_leverage: ordinary prevention multiplied by centered pre-action leverage only for the non-clutch residual
channel_contract.regular_penalty: periods 1-4 only, Beta-regularized expectation, entered once
channel_contract.shootout: period 5 credited goalkeeper saves only; off-target and woodwork receive zero goalkeeper credit; raw and bounded WPA both published
channel_contract.support: availability-renormalized cross/claim, sweeping, and distribution channels; bounded and secondary
channel_contract.anti_double_count_rule: primary PSxG always contains prevention once; clutch and state leverage contain only the residual above a unit multiplier and are mutually exclusive by late-clutch status

selection_rule: Filter to configurations passing every hard gate.
Among hard-gate survivors, maximize number of soft gates passed, preferring Martínez top three when integrity is comparable.
Then maximize PSxG concordance, clutch monotonicity margin, bootstrap top-eight stability, and resistance to a single easy-save perturbation.
Use deterministic config id as the final tie-break.
If no configuration passes every hard gate, write candidate-only artifacts and do not change live aliases.
